actions.action: Water thoroughly until water runs out the drainage holes
If soil is bone dry or pulled away from pot edges, soak the pot in a sink or bucket for 20-30 minutes
Check soil moisture an inch down before watering again
Let the pot drain and verify the white pot has drainage holes or lift plant out of cache pot
Move plant out of harsh direct sun into bright indirect light
Check soil again in a few days and watch for perkier leaves and new yellowing

reason: The answer names underwatering as the main cause, puts thorough watering first (matching the fix), and adds no harmful advice beyond a slight underestimate of recovery speed.
